name: sun direction
note: NEGATED is EXPECTED here and must not be 'fixed'. The reference stores the direction the light TRAVELS (pointing down) and negates at its use sites; whoa stores the direction TOWARD the light and dots it straight into N.L. Both are self-consistent. What this probe catches is a use site that forgets which convention it is in, which is exactly how the shadow camera ended up underground.

name: cloud alpha threshold
note: SUSPECT ADDRESS -- do not read this DIFF as a cloud defect. Measured 2026-09-16: reference 79, whoa 127, while 'cloud density (band 3)' is 0.5 in BOTH and the reference's densityOverride is 0. round((1-0.5)*255) is 127/128, so 79 cannot be this formula's output from that density -- either cloudStruct+0x08 is not alphaThreshold or the formula differs. Bytes 127 and 128 do sit nearby (0x00d38dac, 0x00d38db4) at offsets that do not fit the documented layout. Needs the field located in the disassembly before it means anything.
